items.text: Ranchi's real economy runs through a genuine public-sector corridor - Central Coalfields Limited (CCL) and Heavy Engineering Corporation (HEC) both anchor large, stable engineering and operations employment here - running alongside a private-sector track fed by BIT Mesra's nationally reputed engineering pipeline.

Layered on top is a decision most Indian cities never force: a real, structured sports-career pathway through cricket and hockey, backed by JSCA's stadium and academy infrastructure, in the city that is MS Dhoni's own hometown.

Good career counselling here should help you build the kind of high-value skill portfolio backed by the decisions that unlock high income opportunities in that specific mix, not recite generic advice that ignores what actually makes Ranchi's economy different.
